title: Current four-branch opponent turnover and allocation audit
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Retained current-family pool selection may admit few new opponents despite continued candidate production; descriptive coverage can prioritize a general distribution control.
material_change: Read all four fixed2M checkpoint metadata and exact stage3 metric suffixes; quantify candidate admission, active sets, pool-slot observations and seat-street row exposure; no gradient recomputation or new poker.
notes: All four exact current checkpoint/metric suffix hashes match completed terminal review. Candidate coverage matches independent prior pool reconstruction. Pool-slot observations exclude unreported self-play and are not complete physical-hand accounting. Seat-street advantage rows include replay, omit preflop in this diagnostic field, and cannot establish actual optimizer gradient mass. No new poker or optimizer updates.

result.summary: Retained four-branch coverage audit found3 admitted snapshots among447 current candidates; Seed1 connected admitted0/111. All endpoints retained three initial external anchors and two learned snapshots; public/procedural exposure zero.
result.conclusion: Current historical league is nearly static under global historical-loss ranking. This is descriptive mechanism evidence, not proof that refreshing opponents improves poker. Connected route has fewer KL early stops but external gain remains unconfirmed; do not equate update health with strength.
result.decision: Prioritize one anchor-preserving opponent-turnover control over further unchanged-regimen dose or new gradient audits. Preserve optimizer/replay/checkpoints and all historical evidence.
result.next_step: Qualify an opt-in anchor-preserving recent-snapshot selection policy against current loss-kbest on the same two connected endpoints, then preregister bounded multi-seed geometric training and untouched breadth evaluation. Keep self-play fraction and other training settings matched; no Slumbot-specific labels or rules.
